slot_note: wave 2 of oviya13ya's Anomaly Detection lane, from seed AD10 (which turbine gets next summer's one leading-edge repair campaign, and the energy it recovers); the world, decision and quantity are the seed's, the pitfall is re-found from the turbines' 10-minute record
niche: a community-owned wind farm's lost-production analysis choosing the one turbine whose blades get next summer's rope-access leading-edge repair, where three turbines at a conifer plantation's edge run in its eddies, the loch-facing turbine in the smoothest air on the site, the eroded turbine in that neighbour's wake, and the turbine with the worst year has since had its rotor exchanged
answer: CH04; 100 MWh to the nearest 50 MWh (89 MWh over the twelve months)
stakeholder_role: the asset manager of a community-owned wind farm, booking next summer's one leading-edge repair campaign with the rope-access contractor for the board

spine.entity: one turbine's ten-minute record of power, nacelle wind and state

world.geography: Scotland, United Kingdom (an upland moor with a conifer plantation along its western edge)
world.org_type: community benefit society owning and operating a ten-turbine wind farm

driver: Each unit's shortfall against a reference curve is read as the condition a repair fixes, but every record is the average of a capped, curved response over a spread of inputs whose width depends on where the unit stands, so a unit in a wide spread loses output near the cap for reasons no repair touches and ranks first; only the shortfall measured at matched spread isolates the repairable condition.
driver_concrete: Each turbine's energy shortfall against the warranted power curve at the same mean wind is read as leading-edge erosion, but a ten-minute mean power is the curve averaged over the turbulence inside the ten minutes: the plantation-edge turbine, at 2.3 times the open-air turbulence, loses up to a tenth of its power near rated and gains at low wind, so it ranks first on the shortfall though its blades are sound; a partial-load check instead names the loch-facing turbine in the smoothest air; only the shortfall at each record's own turbulence names the eroded turbine, whose 2.4 per cent loss below rated a neighbour's wake hides at low wind.
stump: A competent solver keeps normal operation, corrects for air density, follows the rotor exchange through the lift log and ranks the turbines by energy shortfall against the warranted power curve, choosing the plantation-edge turbine (CH07, 235 MWh); the shortfall at each turbine's own turbulence leaves it sound and names CH04 (89 MWh).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the ten-minute record (normal operation, curtailment, icing, air density, the April rotor exchange) and ranks each turbine's energy shortfall against the warranted power curve over the year picks the plantation-edge turbine, whose shortfall is turbulence, not the turbine with the eroded blades.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the energy each rotor's blades lose to leading-edge erosion, which wind power-performance analysis measures as the power-curve shortfall at matched inflow (turbulence normalisation of a ten-minute power curve, as in IEC 61400-12-1 Annex M), because a ten-minute mean power averages a capped cubic curve over the turbulence; with clinics and visits or pumps and flows in place of turbines and wind there is no capped curve averaged over a per-unit turbulence, and the task dissolves.

a met mast logging UTC interval starts
one power-limited controller state shared by the network operator's ANM limits and a planning condition's night-time noise mode
silent intervals while a controller is isolated for service or a crane job, after converter trips, during a communications outage and a grid loss
the warranted curve as a table in a contract schedule PDF

differentiation.task48: task48 recovers a population its monitor cannot see by regrouping transactions to a two-sided pair grain; task187 keeps the turbine grain and takes out an effect the ten-minute averaging builds into every record (a capped curve averaged over a per-turbine turbulence), so nothing is regrouped and the correction is a comparison at matched spread.
